# LandMode Refactoring: Repeater-Grid wie BundMode

## Context
LandMode (Umsetzer-Ansicht) nutzt aktuell ein Tab-basiertes Layout mit einem einzigen Eingabeformular oben und einer Liste aller Repeater mit ihren Reports darunter. Der User möchte, dass LandMode exakt wie BundMode funktioniert — aber statt Bundesländer als Hauptkategorien werden **Repeater** als Hauptkategorien verwendet. Jede Repeater-Karte hat ein eigenes OP-Feld im Header und ein eigenes Eingabeformular für Rapporte direkt in der Karte.

## Änderungen

### 1. LandMode komplett umschreiben
**Datei:** `client/src/components/LandMode.tsx`

**Struktur (analog zu BundMode):**
- Repeaters gruppiert nach Bundesland (wie jetzt in den Tabs), aber jeder Repeater wird eine eigene **collapsible card** (wie Bundesland-Karten in BundMode)
- Pro Repeater-Card:
  - **Header**: Repeater-Name, OP-Rufzeichen-Input, Report-Count-Badge, Frequenz-Info, Collapse-Toggle
  - **Body**: Report-Liste (Tabelle) + Eingabeformular am Ende
- **Eingabeformular pro Repeater** (wie `BezirkRow` in BundMode):
  - CallsignInput + Rapport (vorausgefüllt "5/9") + Notes + Submit-Button
  - Enter zum Eintragen, Auto-Focus zurück auf Callsign nach Submit
- **Cross-Repeater-Sync entfernen**: Keine Placeholder-Einträge mehr auf anderen Repeatern

**Reuse von BundMode-Patterns:**
- `parseRapport()` — identische Funktion
- `CallsignInput` mit ref für Auto-Focus — selbes Pattern wie in `BezirkRow`
- `EntryForm` interface — identisch
- Collapsible-State via `Set<number>` (Repeater-IDs statt BL-Codes)
- OP-Callsign speichern via `saveOpCallsign()` — selbes API-Pattern

**Neues Sub-Component `RepeaterRow`** (analog zu `BezirkRow`):
- Props: repeater, reports, exerciseId, onReportCreated, onReportUpdated, onReportDeleted, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel
- Eigenes `form` State mit `{ callsign, operator, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' }`
- Submit erstellt Report direkt auf diesem Repeater
- Report-Liste als Tabelle (Zeilen: Index, Callsign, Bezirk-Badge, Rapport, Notes, Delete)

**Layout-Änderungen:**
- Entferne Tab-Navigation komplett
- Entferne globales Eingabeformular
- Repeater als Cards gruppiert nach BL-Header (kleine Überschriften wie "OE1 Wien", "OE2 Salzburg")
- Jede Card: Header klickbar zum Collapse/Expand

### Keine Server-Änderungen nötig
Die API bleibt unverändert — LandMode nutzt dieselben Endpoints wie bisher.

## Verifizierung
1. `nix-shell -p nodejs --run "npm run build"` kompiliert
2. LandMode zeigt Repeater als Cards gruppiert nach Bundesland
3. Jede Card hat OP-Feld, Report-Liste, Eingabeformular
4. Rapport vorausgefüllt mit "5/9", Enter submitted, Auto-Focus auf Callsign
5. Kein Cross-Repeater-Sync (nur der eine Repeater bekommt den Report)
6. Deploy auf host-node-01

    17→  notes: string;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export default function BundMode({ exerciseId, reports, onReportCreated, onReportUpdated, onReportDeleted }: Props) {
    21→  const [bundeslaender, setBundeslaender] = useState<any[]>([]);
    22→  const [bezirke, setBezirke] = useState<any[]>([]);
    23→  const [linkedRepeaters, setLinkedRepeaters] = useState<any[]>([]);
    24→  const [blRepSelection, setBlRepSelection] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
    25→  const [blOpCallsigns, setBlOpCallsigns] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
    26→  const [collapsedBl, setCollapsedBl] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
    27→  const [addRepBl, setAddRepBl] = useState<string | null>(null);
    28→  const [newRepName, setNewRepName] = useState('');
    29→  const [newRepFreq, setNewRepFreq] = useState('');
    30→  const [newRepCallsign, setNewRepCallsign] = useState('');
    31→  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
    32→  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '', notes: '' });
    33→
    34→  useEffect(() => {
    35→    Promise.all([
    36→      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bundeslaender'),
    37→      apiFetch('/api/v1/reference/bezirke'),
    38→      apiFetch('/api/v1/repeaters'),
    39→      apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters`),
    40→    ]).then(([bl, bz, allReps, exReps]) => {
    41→      setBundeslaender(bl);
    42→      setBezirke(bz);
    43→      const linked = allReps.filter((r: any) => r.is_linked);
    44→      setLinkedRepeaters(linked);
    45→      // Initialize per-BL defaults: first linked in that BL, else first overall
    46→      const defaults: Record<string, number> = {};
    47→      const ops: Record<string, string> = {};
    48→      for (const b of bl) {
    49→        const inBl = linked.find((r: any) => r.bundesland_code === b.code);
    50→        const repId = inBl ? inBl.id : (linked[0]?.id ?? 0);
    51→        defaults[b.code] = repId;
    52→        // Load existing OP callsign from exercise_repeaters
    53→        const exRep = exReps.find((er: any) => er.repeater_id === repId);
    54→        ops[b.code] = exRep?.operator_callsign || '';
    55→      }
    56→      setBlRepSelection(defaults);
    57→      setBlOpCallsigns(ops);
    58→    }).catch(() => {});
    59→  }, [exerciseId]);
    60→
    61→  const saveOpCallsign = async (blCode: string, val: string) => {
    62→    const repId = blRepSelection[blCode];
    63→    if (!repId) return;
    64→    try {
    65→      // Ensure exercise_repeater exists, then update
    66→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters`, {
    67→        method: 'POST',
    68→        body: JSON.stringify({ repeater_id: repId, operator_callsign: val || null }),
    69→      });
    70→    } catch {
    71→      // Already exists, just patch
    72→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/repeaters/${repId}`, {
    73→        method: 'PATCH',
    74→        body: JSON.stringify({ operator_callsign: val || null }),
    75→      });
    76→    }
    77→  };
    78→
    79→  const addRepeater = async (blCode: string) => {
    80→    if (!newRepName && !newRepFreq) return;
    81→    const name = newRepName || `Direkte ${newRepFreq}`;
    82→    const freq = newRepFreq ? parseFloat(newRepFreq) : null;
    83→    try {
    84→      const rep = await apiFetch('/api/v1/repeaters', {
    85→        method: 'POST',
    86→        body: JSON.stringify({
    87→          short_name: name,
    88→          site_name: name,
    89→          frequency_mhz: freq,
    90→          callsign: newRepCallsign || null,
    91→          band: freq ? (freq > 400 ? '70cm' : freq > 200 ? '23cm' : '2m') : null,
    92→          type: 'repeater',
    93→          bundesland_code: blCode,
    94→        }),
    95→      });
    96→      setLinkedRepeaters(prev => [...prev, rep]);
    97→      setNewRepName('');
    98→      setNewRepFreq('');
    99→      setNewRepCallsign('');
   100→      setAddRepBl(null);
   101→    } catch {}
   102→  };
   103→
   104→  const toggleBl = (code: string) => {
   105→    setCollapsedBl(prev => {
   106→      const next = new Set(prev);
   107→      if (next.has(code)) next.delete(code); else next.add(code);
   108→      return next;
   109→    });
   110→  };
   111→
   112→  const parseRapport = (raw: string) => {
   113→    const match = raw.match(/^(\d)\/(\d)(.*)$/);
   114→    if (!match) return { readability: null, strength: null, db_over_s9: null };
   115→    return {
   116→      readability: parseInt(match[1]),
   117→      strength: parseInt(match[2]),
   118→      db_over_s9: match[3]?.trim() || null,
   119→    };
   120→  };
   121→
   122→  const handleBezirkSubmit = async (bezirkCode: string, repeaterId: number, form: EntryForm) => {
   123→    try {
   124→      if (!repeaterId) return;
   125→      const operator = await getOrCreateOperator(form.callsign, form.operator);
   126→      if (!operator) return;
   127→
   128→      const parsed = parseRapport(form.rapport);
   129→
   130→      try {
   131→        const report = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports`, {
   132→          method: 'POST',
   133→          body: JSON.stringify({
   134→            operator_id: operator.id,
   135→            repeater_id: repeaterId,
   136→            ...parsed,
   137→            notes: form.notes || null,
   138→          }),
   139→        });
   140→        onReportCreated(report);
   141→      } catch (err: any) {
   142→        if (err.message?.includes('existiert')) {
   143→          const existing = reports.find(r => r.operator_id === operator.id && r.repeater_id === repeaterId);
   144→          if (existing) {
   145→            const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${existing.id}`, {
   146→              method: 'PATCH',
   147→              body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: form.notes || null }),
   148→            });
   149→            onReportUpdated(updated);
   150→          }
   151→        }
   152→      }
   153→    } catch {
   154→    }
   155→  };
   156→
   157→  const handleEdit = (report: any) => {
   158→    setEditingId(report.id);
   159→    setEditForm({
   160→      callsign: report.callsign,
   161→      operator: { id: report.operator_id, callsign: report.callsign },
   162→      rapport: report.readability && report.strength ? `${report.readability}/${report.strength}${report.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '',
   163→      notes: report.notes || '',
   164→    });
   165→  };
   166→
   167→  const handleUpdate = async () => {
   168→    if (!editingId) return;
   169→    const parsed = parseRapport(editForm.rapport);
   170→    try {
   171→      const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${editingId}`, {
   172→        method: 'PATCH',
   173→        body: JSON.stringify({ ...parsed, notes: editForm.notes || null }),
   174→      });
   175→      onReportUpdated(updated);
   176→      setEditingId(null);
   177→    } catch {}
   178→  };
   179→
   180→  const handleDelete = async (reportId: number) => {
   181→    if (!confirm('Rapport löschen?')) return;
   182→    try {
   183→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports/${reportId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
   184→      onReportDeleted(reportId);
   185→    } catch {}
   186→  };
   187→
   188→  return (
   189→    <div className="space-y-2">
   190→      {bundeslaender.filter(bl => !bl.is_international).map(bl => {
   191→        const blBezirke = bezirke.filter(b => b.bundesland_code === bl.code);
   192→        const defaultRepId = blRepSelection[bl.code] || 0;
   193→        // Match reports by repeater's Bundesland (where the report was entered)
   194→        const blReports = reports.filter(r => r.repeater_bundesland_code === bl.code);
   195→        const isCollapsed = collapsedBl.has(bl.code);
   196→        const reportCount = blReports.filter(r => !r.is_op_marker && r.readability).length;
   197→
   198→        return (
   199→          <div key={bl.code} className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm">
   200→            <div className="bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 flex items-center justify-between border-b">
   201→              <div
   202→                onClick={() => toggleBl(bl.code)}
   203→                className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-100 rounded px-1 -mx-1"
   204→              >
   205→                <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{isCollapsed ? '▶' : '▼'}</span>
   206→                <span className="font-medium text-sm">{bl.name}</span>
   207→                <span className="bg-[#0d6efd] text-white text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">{reportCount}</span>
   208→              </div>
   209→              <div className="flex items-center gap-2" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
   210→                <button
   211→                  onClick={() => setAddRepBl(addRepBl === bl.code ? null : bl.code)}
   212→                  className="text-xs text-gray-400 hover:text-blue-600"
   213→                >
   214→                  + Umsetzer
   215→                </button>
   216→                <label className="text-xs text-gray-500">OP:</label>
   217→                <input
   218→                  type="text"
   219→                  value={blOpCallsigns[bl.code] || ''}
   220→                  onChange={e => setBlOpCallsigns(prev => ({ ...prev, [bl.code]: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   221→                  onBlur={e => saveOpCallsign(bl.code, e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
   222→                  placeholder="Rufzeichen"
   223→                  className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase w-24 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   224→                />
   225→              </div>
   226→            </div>
   227→
   228→            {!isCollapsed && (
   229→              <div>
   230→                {addRepBl === bl.code && (
   231→                  <div className="px-3 py-2 bg-blue-50 border-b flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap">
   232→                    <input
   233→                      type="text"
   234→                      value={newRepName}
   235→                      onChange={e => setNewRepName(e.target.value)}
   236→                      placeholder="Name"
   237→                      className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs w-28 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   238→                      autoFocus
   239→                    />
   240→                    <input
   241→                      type="text"
   242→                      value={newRepFreq}
   243→                      onChange={e => setNewRepFreq(e.target.value)}
   244→                      placeholder="MHz"
   245→                      className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   246→                    />
   247→                    <input
   248→                      type="text"
   249→                      value={newRepCallsign}
   250→                      onChange={e => setNewRepCallsign(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
   251→                      placeholder="Rufz."
   252→                      className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono uppercase w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   253→                    />
   254→                    <button
   255→                      onClick={() => addRepeater(bl.code)}
   256→                      className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs"
   257→                    >
   258→                      OK
   259→                    </button>
   260→                    <button
   261→                      onClick={() => { setAddRepBl(null); setNewRepName(''); setNewRepFreq(''); setNewRepCallsign(''); }}
   262→                      className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 text-xs"
   263→                    >
   264→                      Abbrechen
   265→                    </button>
   266→                  </div>
   267→                )}
   268→                <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
   269→                  {blBezirke.map(bz => {
   270→                    const bzReports = blReports.filter(r => r.bezirk_code === bz.code);
   271→                    return (
   272→                      <BezirkRow
   273→                        key={bz.code}
   274→                        bezirk={bz}
   275→                        reports={bzReports}
   276→                        linkedRepeaters={linkedRepeaters}
   277→                        defaultRepeaterId={defaultRepId}
   278→                        onSubmit={(repeaterId, form) => handleBezirkSubmit(bz.code, repeaterId, form)}
   279→                        onEdit={handleEdit}
   280→                        onDelete={handleDelete}
   281→                        editingId={editingId}
   282→                        editForm={editForm}
   283→                        onEditChange={setEditForm}
   284→                        onEditSave={handleUpdate}
   285→                        onEditCancel={() => setEditingId(null)}
   286→                      />
   287→                    );
   288→                  })}
   289→                  {/* Reports without matching bezirk — shown directly as list items */}
   290→                  {(() => {
   291→                    const bzCodes = new Set(blBezirke.map(b => b.code));
   292→                    const unassigned = blReports.filter(r => !r.bezirk_code || !bzCodes.has(r.bezirk_code));
   293→                    if (unassigned.length === 0) return null;
   294→                    return (
   295→                      <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   296→                        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   297→                          <tbody>
   298→                            {unassigned.map((r, idx) => (
   299→                              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   300→                                {editingId === r.id ? (
   301→                                  <td colSpan={5} className="py-0.5">
   302→                                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1">
   303→                                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   304→                                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" autoFocus />
   305→                                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => setEditForm({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-20" />
   306→                                      <button onClick={handleUpdate} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   307→                                      <button onClick={() => setEditingId(null)} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   308→                                    </div>
   309→                                  </td>
   310→                                ) : (
   311→                                  <>
   312→                                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>
   313→                                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono font-medium cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>{r.callsign}</td>
   314→                                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>
   315→                                      {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
   316→                                    </td>
   317→                                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>
   318→                                    <td className="py-0.5 w-4">
   319→                                      <button onClick={() => handleDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">x</button>
   320→                                    </td>
   321→                                  </>
   322→                                )}
   323→                              </tr>
   324→                            ))}
   325→                          </tbody>
   326→                        </table>
   327→                      </div>
   328→                    );
   329→                  })()}
   330→                </div>
   331→              </div>
   332→            )}
   333→          </div>
   334→        );
   335→      })}
   336→    </div>
   337→  );
   338→}
   339→
   340→interface BezirkRowProps {
   341→  bezirk: any;
   342→  reports: any[];
   343→  linkedRepeaters: any[];
   344→  defaultRepeaterId: number;
   345→  onSubmit: (repeaterId: number, form: EntryForm) => void;
   346→  onEdit: (report: any) => void;
   347→  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
   348→  editingId: number | null;
   349→  editForm: EntryForm;
   350→  onEditChange: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   351→  onEditSave: () => void;
   352→  onEditCancel: () => void;
   353→}
   354→
   355→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, linkedRepeaters, defaultRepeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   356→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   357→  const [repeaterId, setRepeaterId] = useState(defaultRepeaterId);
   358→  const callsignRef = useRef<CallsignInputRef>(null);
   359→
   360→  useEffect(() => {
   361→    if (defaultRepeaterId && !repeaterId) setRepeaterId(defaultRepeaterId);
   362→  }, [defaultRepeaterId]);
   363→
   364→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   365→    e.preventDefault();
   366→    if (!form.callsign && !form.operator) return;
   367→    if (!repeaterId) return;
   368→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   369→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   370→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   371→  };
   372→
   373→  return (
   374→    <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   375→      {bezirk.code !== '??' && (
   376→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
   377→          <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   378→            {bezirk.code}
   379→          </span>
   380→          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{bezirk.name}</span>
   381→          {reports.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">({reports.length})</span>}
   382→        </div>
   383→      )}
   384→
   385→      {reports.length > 0 && (
   386→        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   387→          <tbody>
   388→            {reports.map((r, idx) => (
   389→              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   390→                {editingId === r.id ? (
   391→                  <td colSpan={5} className="py-0.5">
   392→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1">
   393→                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   394→                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" autoFocus />
   395→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-20" />
   396→                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   397→                      <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   398→                    </div>
   399→                  </td>
   400→                ) : (
   401→                  <>
   402→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>
   403→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono font-medium cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.callsign}</td>
   404→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>
   405→                      {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
   406→                    </td>
   407→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>
   408→                    <td className="py-0.5 w-4">
   409→                      <button onClick={() => onDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">x</button>
   410→                    </td>
   411→                  </>
   412→                )}
   413→              </tr>
   414→            ))}
   415→          </tbody>
   416→        </table>
   417→      )}
   418→
   419→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   420→        {linkedRepeaters.length > 0 && (
   421→          <select
   422→            value={repeaterId || ''}
   423→            onChange={e => setRepeaterId(parseInt(e.target.value))}
   424→            className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   425→          >
   426→            {linkedRepeaters.map(r => (
   427→              <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
   428→                {r.site_name || r.short_name}
   429→              </option>
   430→            ))}
   431→          </select>
   432→        )}
   433→        <CallsignInput
   434→          ref={callsignRef}
   435→          value={form.callsign}
   436→          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v }))}
   437→          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign }))}
   438→          className="w-28"
   439→        />
   440→        <input
   441→          type="text"
   442→          value={form.rapport}
   443→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   444→          placeholder="5/9"
   445→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   446→          onKeyDown={e => {
   447→            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
   448→              e.preventDefault();
   449→              setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: `5/${e.key}` }));
   450→            }
   451→          }}
   452→        />
   453→        <input
   454→          type="text"
   455→          value={form.notes}
   456→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
   457→          placeholder="Sonst."
   458→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs flex-1 min-w-[60px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   459→        />
   460→        <button type="submit" className="bg-[#c8102e] hover:bg-[#a00d24] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">
   461→          +
   462→        </button>
   463→      </form>
   464→    </div>
   465→  );
   466→}

> AGENT

I see — `is_linked` is a flag on individual repeaters (0 or 1), where 1 means it's part of a linked repeater network. But it's not the distinction I was looking for.

Let me think about this differently. The user's scenario is:
1. Exercise setup has OE8 repeaters configured (e.g., Dobratsch, Pyramidenkogel) 
2. In BundMode, someone enters reports for OE1 Wien bezirke — these reports use a linked repeater (from BundMode's selection)
3. In LandMode, the OE1 section appears because that linked repeater got added to `exercise_repeaters`
4. User wants: LandMode should only show repeaters/BLs that were explicitly configured, not ones auto-added by BundMode

The cleanest fix: LandMode should filter the `repeaters` prop to exclude repeaters whose Bundesland isn't "configured." But we don't have that info directly.

Let me look at it from a different angle — maybe LandMode should just filter out repeaters that have `is_linked = 1` since those are BundMode's linked repeaters, and LandMode should only show physical repeaters.

> AGENT

Wait — looking at BundMode again, it fetches linked repeaters separately from `/api/v1/repeaters`, and when it saves an OP callsign or submits a report, it POSTs to `exercise_repeaters`. This means BundMode can add linked repeaters to the exercise that weren't originally configured in the setup.

The right fix: filter out linked repeaters (`is_linked`) from LandMode since those are the BundMode ones. LandMode should only show non-linked repeaters.

Now I see the issue. When you enter a callsign in the HA bezirk row, the operator is created/found via `getOrCreateOperator`, but the bezirk_code on the operator might be null or different. The report's `bezirk_code` comes from the operator's record (via SQL JOIN), so the report ends up in the wrong bezirk or in the "unassigned" section.

The fix: pass the bezirk code from the BezirkRow to the submit handler, and update the operator's bezirk_code when submitting from a specific bezirk row. I need to do this in both BundMode and LandMode.

> AGENT

The report creation (line 247-252) returns the report with `o.bezirk_code` from the operator. Since we PATCH the operator's bezirk_code BEFORE creating the report, the returned report will have the correct bezirk_code. But the PATCH to the operator happens async and the operator might be an existing one returned from `getOrCreateOperator`. The issue is the order of operations — we need to ensure the PATCH completes before creating the report.

Looking at the code, I already have the PATCH before the report creation, and I `await` it. But there's a subtlety — when `getOrCreateOperator` returns an existing operator, the `operator` object still has the old `bezirk_code`. The comparison `operator.bezirk_code !== bezirkCode` will work correctly for the first time, but since we're comparing the local object, it should be fine.

The key issue: the PATCH updates the DB, then the INSERT + SELECT for the report joins the operator table and gets the new bezirk_code. This should work correctly in sequence.

Let me build and test.

     1→import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useImperativeHandle, forwardRef } from 'react';
     2→import { apiFetch } from '../services/api';
     3→
     4→interface Props {
     5→  value: string;
     6→  onChange: (value: string) => void;
     7→  onSelect: (operator: any) => void;
     8→  autoFocus?: boolean;
     9→  className?: string;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export interface CallsignInputRef {
    13→  focus: () => void;
    14→}
    15→
    16→const CallsignInput = forwardRef<CallsignInputRef, Props>(({ value, onChange, onSelect, autoFocus, className }, ref) => {
    17→  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState<any[]>([]);
    18→  const [showSuggestions, setShowSuggestions] = useState(false);
    19→  const [selectedIdx, setSelectedIdx] = useState(-1);
    20→  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    21→  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
    22→
    23→  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
    24→    focus: () => inputRef.current?.focus(),
    25→  }));
    26→
    27→  useEffect(() => {
    28→    if (autoFocus && inputRef.current) inputRef.current.focus();
    29→  }, [autoFocus]);
    30→
    31→  const search = (q: string) => {
    32→    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    33→    if (q.length < 1) { setSuggestions([]); setShowSuggestions(false); return; }
    34→    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
    35→      try {
    36→        const results = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}`);
    37→        setSuggestions(results);
    38→        setShowSuggestions(results.length > 0);
    39→        setSelectedIdx(-1);
    40→      } catch {}
    41→    }, 150);
    42→  };
    43→
    44→  const handleChange = (val: string) => {
    45→    const upper = val.toUpperCase();
    46→    onChange(upper);
    47→    search(upper);
    48→  };
    49→
    50→  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    51→    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    52→      e.preventDefault();
    53→      setSelectedIdx(prev => Math.min(prev + 1, suggestions.length - 1));
    54→    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    55→      e.preventDefault();
    56→      setSelectedIdx(prev => Math.max(prev - 1, -1));
    57→    } else if (e.key === 'Enter' && selectedIdx >= 0) {
    58→      e.preventDefault();
    59→      selectSuggestion(suggestions[selectedIdx]);
    60→    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    61→      setShowSuggestions(false);
    62→    }
    63→    // Keyboard shortcuts
    64→    if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
    65→      e.preventDefault();
    66→      onChange(value + `5/${e.key}`);
    67→    }
    68→    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
    69→      e.preventDefault();
    70→      onChange(`OE${e.key}`);
    71→    }
    72→  };
    73→
    74→  const selectSuggestion = (op: any) => {
    75→    onChange(op.callsign);
    76→    onSelect(op);
    77→    setShowSuggestions(false);
    78→    setSuggestions([]);
    79→  };
    80→
    81→  return (
    82→    <div className="relative">
    83→      <input
    84→        ref={inputRef}
    85→        type="text"
    86→        value={value}
    87→        onChange={e => handleChange(e.target.value)}
    88→        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
    89→        onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setShowSuggestions(false), 200)}
    90→        onFocus={() => { if (suggestions.length > 0) setShowSuggestions(true); }}
    91→        className={`border border-gray-300 rounded px-2 py-1 font-mono uppercase text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 ${className || 'w-32'}`}
    92→        placeholder="Rufzeichen"
    93→      />
    94→      {showSuggestions && (
    95→        <div className="absolute z-20 top-full left-0 mt-1 bg-white border rounded shadow-lg max-h-48 overflow-auto w-64">
    96→          {suggestions.map((op, i) => (
    97→            <div
    98→              key={op.id}
    99→              onMouseDown={() => selectSuggestion(op)}
   100→              className={`px-3 py-1.5 cursor-pointer text-sm ${i === selectedIdx ? 'bg-blue-100' : 'hover:bg-gray-100'}`}
   101→            >
   102→              <span className="font-mono font-bold">{op.callsign}</span>
   103→              {op.name && <span className="ml-2 text-gray-500">{op.name}</span>}
   104→              {op.bezirk_code && <span className="ml-1 text-xs bg-gray-200 rounded px-1">{op.bezirk_code}</span>}
   105→              {op.bundesland_name && <span className="ml-1 text-xs text-gray-400">{op.bundesland_name}</span>}
   106→              {op.total_reports > 0 && <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-blue-500">{op.total_reports} Rap.</span>}
   107→            </div>
   108→          ))}
   109→        </div>
   110→      )}
   111→    </div>
   112→  );
   113→});
   114→
   115→export default CallsignInput;
   116→

Now I have all the files. Let me analyze them for mobile/tablet responsive design issues.

## Mobile/Tablet Responsive Design Issues Report

Based on analysis of all 10 files for devices at 320-414px (phone) and 768-1024px (tablet) widths:

---

### **Layout.tsx**
**Line 15-40: Navbar layout issues**
- Line 15: Fixed navbar with `px-4 py-2` - OK but needs review for nav collapse on mobile
- Line 16-30: Nav items in horizontal flex without wrapping - Desktop logo, title, "Dashboard", "Rufzeichen" links will compress severely on phones <400px
- Line 31-38: Right-side flex with username + logout button stays together - May overflow on phones
- **Issue**: No responsive adjustments; text will truncate or overflow on 320px screens. Navbar needs `flex-col` breakpoint or hamburger menu.

---

### **BundMode.tsx**
**Line 242-277: Add repeater form**
- Line 242: `flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap` - Form has input fields with fixed widths:
  - Line 248: `w-28` (Name input)
  - Line 256: `w-20` (Frequency input)
  - Line 263: `w-20` (Callsign input)
- **Issue**: On 320px screens, four inputs + button in a row = severe cramping; flex-wrap helps but tight vertical stacking still problematic.

**Line 307-338: Tables in unassigned reports section**
- Line 307: `table className="w-full text-xs"` but table has 5 columns (<td> with class `w-4`, `w-24` widths)
- Line 315: `w-20` inputs in edit mode
- **Issue**: Table columns don't stack on mobile; horizontal overflow likely. No responsive table breakpoint to convert to card/list view.

**Line 430-475: Form in BezirkRow**
- Line 430: `flex items-center gap-1` with:
  - Line 435: `select` without width constraint
  - Line 449: `w-28` CallsignInput
  - Line 456: `w-20` rapport input
  - Line 469: `flex-1 min-w-[60px]` notes input
- **Issue**: On 320px phones, form items stack horizontally with fixed widths causing overflow. All inputs need `flex-col` on mobile.

---

### **LandMode.tsx**
**Line 193-221: Repeater card header**
- Line 193: Header with flex items spanning multiple lines of info:
  - Line 199: `text-sm` repeater name
  - Line 200: Badge with count
  - Line 202-208: Frequency/offset/CTCSS all inline text-xs
- **Issue**: On 320px, header becomes cramped; frequency info should stack or hide.

**Line 252-282: Tables with 5 columns**
- Same table structure as BundMode
- **Issue**: Horizontal scrolling on phones; no mobile card view alternative.

**Line 395-426: BezirkRow form**
- Identical to BundMode line 430-475
- **Issue**: Same horizontal overflow problem.

---

### **ExercisePage.tsx**
**Line 111-136: Header and controls**
- Line 111: `flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2`
- Line 112-114: Title with exercise name + date
- Line 115-135: Right side with OP input field + 2 links
- **Issue**: On 320px, flex-wrap helps but "Einrichten" and "Auswertung" buttons stack awkwardly with the title. No specific mobile layout.

**Line 140-153: Mode toggle buttons**
- Line 140: `flex gap-1 bg-white rounded-lg p-1 shadow-sm w-fit`
- Line 143-152: Two buttons with `px-4 py-1.5`
- **Issue**: `w-fit` means buttons take natural width; text "Land (Umsetzer)" and "Bund (Bundesland)" are long and may not fit side-by-side on 320px screens.

**Line 222: Chart height**
- Line 222: `div style={{ height: 300 }}` - Fixed 300px height
- **Issue**: Chart takes up entire viewport on phones (usually ~568px tall). Chart will be unusable. Should be responsive.

---

### **ExerciseSetupPage.tsx**
**Line 184: Bundesland selection grid**
- Line 184: `grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-5 lg:grid-cols-9 gap-2`
- Issue: Shows 3 columns on mobile, which is OK, but buttons have:
  - Line 203: `font-bold` label text (e.g., "OE1")
  - Line 204: `text-xs truncate w-full text-center` name (e.g., "Wien")
  - Line 205: `text-xs` count badge
- **Issue on 320px**: 3 columns × 9 Bundesländer = 3 rows; button text may be too small but otherwise manageable. However, with `px-1` padding, buttons are very narrow and cramped.

**Line 268-274: Add custom repeater form**
- Line 268: `flex gap-2 flex-wrap`
- Five input fields: `Name` (min-w-[120px]), `Frequenz` (w-28), `Offset` (w-24), `CTCSS` (w-24), `Rufzeichen` (w-24)
- **Issue**: On 320px, form fields are constrained at min-width/fixed width, causing horizontal overflow even with flex-wrap. All inputs need to be `w-full` on mobile and stack vertically.

**Line 322-324: Similar form for Simplex**
- Same issue as above.

**Line 242-260: Repeater item layout**
- Line 242: `flex items-center gap-3 py-2`
- Line 243: `flex-1` label with multiple inline elements (checkbox, name, frequency, CTCSS, badges)
- **Issue**: On 320px, text wraps but icons/badges don't; layout becomes messy. Should stack on mobile.

---

### **DashboardPage.tsx**
**Line 196: Summary cards grid**
- Line 196: `grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3`
- Cards display 2 columns on mobile
- **Issue**: Cards show 2×2 on 320px, which is fine. But `p-4` padding + centered text with `text-3xl` numbers may be tight. Card width at 320px would be ~140px (allowing for gap/margin), making the layout cramped. Consider reducing padding on mobile.

**Line 263-323: Exercise table**
- Line 263: `table className="w-full text-sm"` with 5 columns (Datum, Name, Teilnehmer, Rapporte, links)
- Line 266-270: `px-4 py-2` header cells
- **Issue**: Table columns don't stack on 320px. On phones, table will overflow horizontally. No card/list view fallback. "Öffnen" and "Auswertung" links in last column become tiny.

**Line 130-190: Exercise creation form**
- Line 130: `flex items-end gap-3 flex-wrap`
- Line 142: `flex gap-2` with select and optional input
- Line 140: `flex-1 min-w-[200px]`
- **Issue**: On 320px, `min-w-[200px]` is too wide (exceeds available space). Form will overflow. Needs `w-full` on mobile and vertical stacking.

---

### **LoginPage.tsx**
**Line 29: Login form container**
- Line 29: `w-full max-w-sm` — OK for centering, but `max-w-sm` = 384px, smaller than some tablets
- Line 39, 51: Inputs with `w-full`
- **Issue**: On 320px screens, form is responsive. On 414px and above, form looks reasonable. No specific issues, but could add `px-4` for safe area on notched phones.

---

### **OperatorsPage.tsx**
**Line 93-101: Add operator form**
- Line 93: `flex gap-2 flex-wrap`
- Seven input fields with fixed widths:
  - Line 94: `w-28` (Rufzeichen)
  - Line 95: `w-32` (Name)
  - Line 96: `w-32` (QTH)
  - Line 97: `w-16` (Bezirk)
  - Line 98: `w-12` (BL)
  - Plus two buttons
- **Issue**: On 320px, form overflows horizontally. Fields need `w-full` and `flex-col` on mobile.

**Line 106-156: Operators table**
- Line 106: `table className="w-full text-sm"` with 7 columns (Rufzeichen, Name, QTH, Bezirk, BL, Ausstattung, Action)
- Line 109-115: Header cells with `px-3 py-2`
- **Issue**: 7 columns won't fit on 320px. Horizontal scrolling required. No mobile-friendly card layout. Table should collapse to card view or stacked rows.

**Line 122-152: Table rows (edit/view modes)**
- Multiple fixed-width inputs: `w-24`, `w-12`, `w-10`
- **Issue**: Inline editing doesn't work on 320px; inputs overflow.

---

### **CallsignInput.tsx**
**Line 95: Suggestions dropdown**
- Line 95: `w-64` fixed width
- **Issue**: On 320px screens, `w-64` (256px) exceeds available viewport (320px - padding/margin = ~300px). Dropdown will overflow right edge. Should be `w-full` or `max-w-full` with responsive max-height.

**Line 100: Suggestion items**
- Multiple inline elements: callsign (font-mono), name, bezirk badge, bundesland text, report count
- **Issue**: On 320px, all text wraps awkwardly. Should hide less important info (bundesland_name, total_reports) on mobile.

---

### **RunningTotals.tsx**
**Line 11: Sticky bar layout**
- Line 11: `flex flex-wrap gap-4` with `sticky top-0`
- Line 18: `flex flex-wrap gap-3` for per-repeater stats
- **Issue**: On 320px, stats may wrap multiple times, pushing bar down and obscuring content. Gap and padding are generous. Consider `gap-2` and reduced padding (`px-2 py-1`) on mobile.
- Line 18: `border-l border-gray-300 pl-4` creates extra spacing; on 320px, this might push repeater stats off-screen.

---

## Summary Table

| File | Issue Type | Lines | Mobile Problem |
|------|-----------|-------|-----------------|
| Layout.tsx | Navbar overflow | 15-40 | Horizontal overflow on <400px; no hamburger menu |
| BundMode.tsx | Form/Input overflow | 242-277, 430-475 | Fixed widths cause horizontal scrolling |
| BundMode.tsx | Table overflow | 307-338 | 5-column table doesn't stack on mobile |
| LandMode.tsx | Form/Input overflow | 395-426 | Same as BundMode |
| LandMode.tsx | Table overflow | 252-282 | Same as BundMode |
| ExercisePage.tsx | Button overflow | 140-153 | Long button text doesn't fit 320px |
| ExercisePage.tsx | Chart height | 222 | Fixed 300px height unresponsive |
| ExerciseSetupPage.tsx | Form overflow | 268-274, 322-324 | Inputs overflow on 320px |
| ExerciseSetupPage.tsx | Layout cramping | 242-260 | Repeater items don't stack on mobile |
| DashboardPage.tsx | Table overflow | 263-323 | 5-column table + 2-column links unreadable on 320px |
| DashboardPage.tsx | Form overflow | 130-190 | `min-w-[200px]` exceeds 320px width |
| OperatorsPage.tsx | Form overflow | 93-101 | 7 fields + buttons overflow on 320px |
| OperatorsPage.tsx | Table overflow | 106-156 | 7-column table unreadable on mobile; no card view |
| CallsignInput.tsx | Dropdown overflow | 95 | `w-64` exceeds 320px viewport |
| CallsignInput.tsx | Suggestion cramping | 96-108 | Multiple inline badges wrap awkwardly |
| RunningTotals.tsx | Bar overflow | 11, 18 | Sticky bar takes excessive height on 320px |

---

## Priority Fixes (Highest Impact)

1. **Tables**: Convert to card/list view on mobile (BundMode, LandMode, DashboardPage, OperatorsPage)
2. **Form inputs**: Stack vertically on mobile; use `w-full` instead of fixed widths
3. **Navbar**: Add hamburger menu or collapse on <600px
4. **Dropdown (CallsignInput)**: Constrain width to viewport with `max-w-[calc(100vw-20px)]`
5. **Charts**: Use responsive height: `min-h-[250px] md:min-h-[300px]`

   337→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, repeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   338→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   339→  const callsignRef = useRef<CallsignInputRef>(null);
   340→
   341→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   342→    e.preventDefault();
   343→    if (!form.callsign && !form.operator) return;
   344→    onSubmit(form);
   345→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   346→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   347→  };
   348→
   349→  return (
   350→    <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   351→      {bezirk.code !== '??' && (
   352→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
   353→          <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   354→            {bezirk.code}
   355→          </span>
   356→          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{bezirk.name}</span>
   357→          {reports.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">({reports.length})</span>}
   358→        </div>
   359→      )}
   360→
   361→      {reports.length > 0 && (
   362→        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   363→          <tbody>
   364→            {reports.map((r, idx) => (
   365→              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   366→                {editingId === r.id ? (
   367→                  <td colSpan={5} className="py-0.5">
   368→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1">
   369→                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   370→                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20" autoFocus />
   371→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-20" />
   372→                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   373→                      <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   374→                    </div>
   375→                  </td>
   376→                ) : (
   377→                  <>
   378→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>
   379→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono font-medium cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.callsign}</td>
   380→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>
   381→                      {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
   382→                    </td>
   383→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>
   384→                    <td className="py-0.5 w-4">
   385→                      <button onClick={() => onDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">x</button>
   386→                    </td>
   387→                  </>
   388→                )}
   389→              </tr>
   390→            ))}
   391→          </tbody>
   392→        </table>
   393→      )}
   394→
   395→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   396→        <CallsignInput
   397→          ref={callsignRef}

   399→          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v }))}
   400→          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign }))}
   401→          className="w-28"
   402→        />
   403→        <input
   404→          type="text"
   405→          value={form.rapport}
   406→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   407→          placeholder="5/9"
   408→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   409→          onKeyDown={e => {

   351→interface BezirkRowProps {

   365→
   366→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, linkedRepeaters, defaultRepeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   367→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   368→  const [repeaterId, setRepeaterId] = useState(defaultRepeaterId);
   369→  const callsignRef = useRef<CallsignInputRef>(null);
   370→
   371→  useEffect(() => {
   372→    if (defaultRepeaterId && !repeaterId) setRepeaterId(defaultRepeaterId);

   374→
   375→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   376→    e.preventDefault();
   377→    if (!form.callsign && !form.operator) return;
   378→    if (!repeaterId) return;
   379→    onSubmit(repeaterId, form);
   380→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   381→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   382→  };
   383→
   384→  return (
   385→    <div className="px-3 py-1.5">
   386→      {bezirk.code !== '??' && (
   387→        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
   388→          <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   389→            {bezirk.code}
   390→          </span>
   391→          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{bezirk.name}</span>
   392→          {reports.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">({reports.length})</span>}

   395→
   396→      {reports.length > 0 && (
   397→        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   398→          <tbody>

   406→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-20" />
   407→                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>

   415→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>

   417→                    </td>

   468→          placeholder="Sonst."
   469→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs flex-1 min-w-[60px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   470→        />
   471→        <button type="submit" className="bg-[#c8102e] hover:bg-[#a00d24] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs">
   472→          +

   474→      </form>
   475→    </div>

Deployed successfully. Here's a summary of all mobile/tablet optimizations applied across 10 files:

**Layout.tsx** - Responsive navbar with mobile nav row, reduced padding, responsive logo size, slogan hidden on mobile

**CallsignInput.tsx** - Dropdown constrained to `max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)]` to prevent overflow

**RunningTotals.tsx** - Responsive gaps/padding/text sizes

**ExercisePage.tsx** - Stacking title on mobile, full-width mode toggle, smaller buttons/inputs

**DashboardPage.tsx** - Responsive summary cards, responsive chart height (`h-48 sm:h-[300px]`), hidden Name column on mobile, shortened table headers

**OperatorsPage.tsx** - Hidden QTH/BL columns on mobile, Ausstattung hidden until md breakpoint, overflow-x-auto

**LandMode.tsx** - Repeater card headers: truncated names, hidden frequency/offset/CTCSS on small screens, smaller OP input, responsive BezirkRow forms with hidden notes column on mobile

**BundMode.tsx** - Same pattern as LandMode: responsive card headers, hidden "+ Umsetzer" button on mobile, responsive BezirkRow forms

**ExerciseSetupPage.tsx** - Stacking header, responsive section padding/headings, hidden repeater frequency details on small screens

**ReportsPage.tsx** - Responsive summary cards, chart heights (`h-48 sm:h-[350px]` instead of fixed 350px), responsive participant table with hidden Name/Bundesland columns, overflow-x-auto on all tables, shortened header labels

   128→            </div>

wrapper.style.cssText = 'padding:24px;background:#f3f4f6;';\n    const parent = cardRef.current.parentNode!;\n    const next = cardRef.current.nextSibling;\n    parent.insertBefore(wrapper, cardRef.current);\n    wrapper.appendChild(header);\n    wrapper.appendChild(cardRef.current);\n    wrapper.appendChild(footer);\n    try {\n      const url = await toPng(wrapper, { backgroundColor: card back to original position\n      if (next) parent.insertBefore(cardRef.current, next); else parent.appendChild(cardRef.current);\n      wrapper.remove();\n      setExporting(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const downloadFullPage = async () => {\n    if (!pageRef.current || !exercise) return;\n    setExporting(true);\n    const header = createExportHeader();\n    const footer = pageRef.current.appendChild(footer);\n    try {\n      const url = await toPng(pageRef.current, {\n        backgroundColor: '#f3f4f6',\n        pixelRatio: 2,\n        filter: (node) => {\n {
  "command": "ssh host-node-01 \"docker exec bosarsalog node -e \\\"\nconst crypto = require('crypto');\nconst db = require('better-sqlite3')('/data/bosarsalog.db');\n\n// 1. Create simplex frequency for 80m 3646 kHz = 3.646 MHz\nconst insertRep = db.prepare(\\\\\\`INSERT INTO repeaters (short_name, site_name, band, callsign, frequency_mhz, offset_mhz, ctcss_hz, burst_hz, type, is_linked, sort_order, bundesland_code, is_custom) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\\\\\\`);\nconst repResult = insertRep.run('80m Notfunk 3646 kHz', null, '80m', null, 3.646, null, null, null, 'simplex', 0, 100, null, 0);\nconst repId = repResult.lastInsertRowid;\nconsole.log('Created repeater id:', repId);\n\n// 2. Calculate 1st Wednesday of each month in 2026\nconst dates = [];\nfor (let month = 0; month < 12; month++) {\n  // Find 1st Wednesday (day 3)\n  const d = new Date(2026, month, 1);\n  while (d.getDay() !== 3) d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);\n  const yyyy = d.getFullYear();\n  const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');\n  const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');\n  dates.push(\\\\\\`\\\\\\${yyyy}-\\\\\\${mm}-\\\\\\${dd}\\\\\\`);\n}\nconsole.log('Dates:', dates);\n\n// 3. Create exercises and assign repeater\nconst insertEx = db.prepare('INSERT INTO exercises (id, name, date) VALUES (?, ?, ?)');\nconst insertExRep = db.prepare('INSERT INTO exercise_repeaters (exercise_id, repeater_id, operator_callsign) VALUES (?, ?, ?)');\n\nfor (const date of dates) {\n  const id = crypto.randomUUID();\n  const name = 'Notfunk Runde ' + date;\n  insertEx.run(id, name, date);\n  insertExRep.run(id, Number(repId), null);\n  console.log('Created exercise:', name, id);\n}\n\nconsole.log('Done! Created', dates.length, 'exercises');\n\\\"\" 2>&1",
  "description": "Create 80m simplex frequency and all 2026 Notfunk Runde exercises"
}

     1→import { Router } from 'express';

     4→export const exportRouter = Router();
     5→
     6→// Bund export (Bundesland-grouped)
     7→exportRouter.get('/exercises/:id/bund', (req, res) => {
     8→  const db = getDb();
     9→  const exercise = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM exercises WHERE id = ?').get(req.params.id) as any;
    10→  if (!exercise) { res.status(404).json({ error: 'Nicht gefunden' }); return; }
    11→
    12→  const reports = db.prepare(`
    13→    SELECT sr.*, o.callsign, o.bezirk_code, o.bundesland_code,
    14→      bl.name as bundesland_name, bz.name as bezirk_name,
    15→      r.short_name as repeater_name,
    16→      ep.abbreviation as ep_abbr
    17→    FROM signal_reports sr
    18→    JOIN operators o ON o.id = sr.operator_id
    19→    JOIN repeaters r ON r.id = sr.repeater_id
    20→    LEFT JOIN bundeslaender bl ON bl.code = o.bundesland_code
    21→    LEFT JOIN bezirke bz ON bz.code = o.bezirk_code
    22→    LEFT JOIN einstiegspunkte ep ON ep.id = sr.einstiegspunkt_id
    23→    WHERE sr.exercise_id = ? AND sr.is_op_marker = 0
    24→    ORDER BY bl.sort_order, bz.code, o.callsign
    25→  `).all(req.params.id) as any[];

    27→  let text = `BOS-ARSA Krisenkommunikationsübung — ${exercise.date}\n`;

    29→  text += '='.repeat(60) + '\n\n';
    30→
    31→  let currentBl = '';
    32→  let currentBz = '';
    33→  for (const r of reports) {
    34→    if (r.bundesland_name !== currentBl) {
    35→      currentBl = r.bundesland_name || 'Sonstige';
    36→      text += `\n── ${currentBl} ──\n`;
    37→      currentBz = '';
    38→    }
    39→    if (r.bezirk_code !== currentBz) {
    40→      currentBz = r.bezirk_code || '??';
    41→      text += `  [${currentBz}] ${r.bezirk_name || ''}\n`;

    43→    const rapport = r.readability && r.strength

     6→export const exercisesRouter = Router();

     8→// List all exercises with summary stats
     9→exercisesRouter.get('/', (_req, res) => {
    10→  const db = getDb();
    11→  const exercises = db.prepare(`
    12→    SELECT e.id, e.date, e.name, e.notes,
    13→      (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT operator_id) FROM signal_reports WHERE exercise_id = e.id AND is_op_marker = 0) as participant_count,

   137→    GROUP BY COALESCE(o.bundesland_code, '0' || SUBSTR(o.callsign, 3, 1))

    89→    const isActive = activeRepeaters.some(r => r.repeater_id === repeaterId);
    90→    if (isActive) {
    91→      if (!isAdmin) return; // only admin can deactivate
    92→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters/${repeaterId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    93→      setActiveRepeaters(prev => prev.filter(r => r.repeater_id !== repeaterId));
    94→    } else {
    95→      await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters`, {
    96→        method: 'POST',
    97→        body: JSON.stringify({ repeater_id: repeaterId }),
    98→      });
    99→      const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters`);
   100→      setActiveRepeaters(updated);
   101→    }
   102→  };
   103→
   104→  const addCustomRepeater = async (bundeslandCode: string | null) => {
   105→    if (!newRepName && !newRepFreq) return;

   107→    const name = newRepName || `Direkte ${newRepFreq}`;
   108→    const rep = await apiFetch('/api/v1/repeaters', {
   109→      method: 'POST',
   110→      body: JSON.stringify({
   111→        short_name: name,
   112→        frequency_mhz: newRepFreq ? parseFloat(newRepFreq) : null,
   113→        offset_mhz: newRepOffset ? parseFloat(newRepOffset) : null,
   114→        ctcss_hz: newRepCtcss ? parseFloat(newRepCtcss) : null,
   115→        callsign: newRepCallsign || null,
   116→        band: newRepFreq ? (parseFloat(newRepFreq) > 400 ? '70cm' : parseFloat(newRepFreq) > 200 ? '23cm' : '2m') : null,
   117→        type,
   118→        bundesland_code: bundeslandCode,
   119→      }),
   120→    });
   121→    setAllRepeaters(prev => [...prev, rep]);
   122→    // Auto-activate it
   123→    await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters`, {
   124→      method: 'POST',
   125→      body: JSON.stringify({ repeater_id: rep.id }),
   126→    });
   127→    const updated = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${id}/repeaters`);

   141→      else next.add(blCode);
   142→      return next;
   143→    });
   144→  };

   159→            Zurück

   113→      if (!operator) return;
   114→
   115→      // Set operator's bezirk_code to match the row they were entered in
   116→      if (bezirkCode && bezirkCode !== '??') {
   117→        apiFetch(`/api/v1/operators/${operator.id}`, {
   118→          method: 'PATCH',
   119→          body: JSON.stringify({ bezirk_code: bezirkCode }),
   120→        }).catch(() => {});
   121→      }

   123→      const parsed = parseRapport(form.rapport);
   124→
   125→      try {
   126→        const report = await apiFetch(`/api/v1/exercises/${exerciseId}/reports`, {

   129→            operator_id: operator.id,

   131→            ...parsed,
   132→            notes: form.notes || null,
   133→          }),

   135→        // Force bezirk_code on report so it shows in the correct row immediately
   136→        if (bezirkCode && bezirkCode !== '??') report.bezirk_code = bezirkCode;
   137→        onReportCreated(report);

   146→            if (bezirkCode && bezirkCode !== '??') updated.bezirk_code = bezirkCode;

   323→interface BezirkRowProps {
   324→  bezirk: any;
   325→  reports: any[];
   326→  repeaterId: number;
   327→  onSubmit: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   328→  onEdit: (report: any) => void;
   329→  onDelete: (id: number) => void;
   330→  editingId: number | null;
   331→  editForm: EntryForm;
   332→  onEditChange: (form: EntryForm) => void;
   333→  onEditSave: () => void;
   334→  onEditCancel: () => void;
   335→}
   336→
   337→function BezirkRow({ bezirk, reports, repeaterId, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, editingId, editForm, onEditChange, onEditSave, onEditCancel }: BezirkRowProps) {
   338→  const [form, setForm] = useState<EntryForm>({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   339→  const callsignRef = useRef<CallsignInputRef>(null);
   340→
   341→  const handleSubmit = (e: FormEvent) => {
   342→    e.preventDefault();
   343→    if (!form.callsign && !form.operator) return;
   344→    onSubmit(form);
   345→    setForm({ callsign: '', operator: null, rapport: '5/9', notes: '' });
   346→    setTimeout(() => callsignRef.current?.focus(), 50);
   347→  };
   348→
   349→  return (
   350→    <div className="px-2 sm:px-3 py-1.5">
   351→      {bezirk.code !== '??' && (
   352→        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 mb-1">
   353→          <span className={`text-xs font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-white ${bezirk.is_capital ? 'bg-[#dc3545]' : 'bg-[#6c757d]'}`}>
   354→            {bezirk.code}
   355→          </span>
   356→          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate">{bezirk.name}</span>
   357→          {reports.length > 0 && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0">({reports.length})</span>}
   358→        </div>
   359→      )}
   360→
   361→      {reports.length > 0 && (
   362→        <table className="w-full text-xs mb-1">
   363→          <tbody>
   364→            {reports.map((r, idx) => (
   365→              <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-blue-50 group">
   366→                {editingId === r.id ? (
   367→                  <td colSpan={5} className="py-0.5">
   368→                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-blue-50 rounded p-1 flex-wrap">
   369→                      <span className="font-mono font-medium">{r.callsign}</span>
   370→                      <input value={editForm.rapport} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() })} className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" autoFocus />
   371→                      <input value={editForm.notes} onChange={e => onEditChange({ ...editForm, notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="Sonst." className="border rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-xs w-16 sm:w-20" />
   372→                      <button onClick={onEditSave} className="text-green-600 text-xs font-bold">OK</button>
   373→                      <button onClick={onEditCancel} className="text-gray-400 text-xs">X</button>
   374→                    </div>
   375→                  </td>
   376→                ) : (
   377→                  <>
   378→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-400 w-4">{idx + 1}</td>
   379→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono font-medium cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.callsign}</td>
   380→                    <td className="py-0.5 font-mono text-gray-500 w-16 sm:w-24 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>
   381→                      {r.readability && r.strength ? `${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}
   382→                    </td>
   383→                    <td className="py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer hidden sm:table-cell" onClick={() => onEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>
   384→                    <td className="py-0.5 w-4">
   385→                      <button onClick={() => onDelete(r.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100">x</button>
   386→                    </td>
   387→                  </>
   388→                )}
   389→              </tr>
   390→            ))}
   391→          </tbody>
   392→        </table>
   393→      )}
   394→
   395→      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="flex items-center gap-1">
   396→        <CallsignInput
   397→          ref={callsignRef}
   398→          value={form.callsign}
   399→          onChange={v => setForm(f => ({ ...f, callsign: v }))}
   400→          onSelect={op => setForm(f => ({ ...f, operator: op, callsign: op.callsign }))}
   401→          className="w-24 sm:w-28"
   402→        />
   403→        <input
   404→          type="text"
   405→          value={form.rapport}
   406→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: e.target.value.toUpperCase() }))}
   407→          placeholder="5/9"
   408→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs w-16 sm:w-20 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   409→          onKeyDown={e => {
   410→            if (e.altKey && e.key >= '1' && e.key <= '9') {
   411→              e.preventDefault();
   412→              setForm(f => ({ ...f, rapport: `5/${e.key}` }));
   413→            }
   414→          }}
   415→        />
   416→        <input
   417→          type="text"
   418→          value={form.notes}
   419→          onChange={e => setForm(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))}
   420→          placeholder="Sonst."
   421→          className="border border-gray-300 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs flex-1 min-w-[40px] sm:min-w-[60px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500"
   422→        />
   423→        <button type="submit" className="bg-[#c8102e] hover:bg-[#a00d24] text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs flex-shrink-0">
   424→          +
   425→        </button>
   426→      </form>
   427→    </div>
   428→  );
   429→}

`${r.readability}/${r.strength}${r.db_over_s9 || ''}` : '—'}\n                                  </td>\n                                  <td className=\"py-0.5 text-gray-500 cursor-pointer\" onClick={() => handleEdit(r)}>{r.notes || ''}</td>\n                                  <td className=\"py-0.5 w-4\">\n                                    <button onClick={() => handleDelete(r.id)} className=\"text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100\">x</button>\n                                  </td>\n                                </>\n                              )}\n                            </tr>\n                          ))}\n                        </tbody>\n                      </table>\n                    </div>\n                  );\n                })()}\n              </>\n            ) : (\n              /* No Bezirke — flat list with input form */\n              <FlatReportRow\n                reports={repReports}\n                repeaterId={rep.repeater_id}\n                onSubmit={(form) => handleBezirkSubmit('', rep.repeater_id, form)}\n                onEdit={handleEdit}\n                onDelete={handleDelete}\n                editingId={editingId}\n                editForm={editForm}\n                onEditChange={setEditForm}\n                onEditSave={handleUpdate}\n                onEditCancel={() => setEditingId(null)}\n              />\n            )}\n          </div>\n        )}"

The file is at the path found via: `glob.glob(\"/home/achildrenmile/Downloads/2026*BOS*xlsx\")[0]`\n\nUse nix-shell: `nix-shell -p python3Packages.openpyxl --run \"python3 script.py\"`\n\nWrite a Python script to `/tmp/extract_qsos.py` that:\n1. Opens the xlsx workbook (data_only=True)\n2. Looks at sheets '20260104' and '20260111' (the two sheets with data — Jan 4 and Jan 11 exercises)\n3. For each sheet, the columns are:\n   - Col A (0): Rufzeichen (callsign)\n   - Col B (1): Zusatz (suffix like \"p\", \"m\", \"/8\", \"mobil\")\n   - Col C (2): Anwesend 1 \n   - Col D (3): Anwesend (0 or 1)\n   - Cols P onwards contain rapport data per repeater (the column headers at row 1 describe which repeater)\n4. Extract all rows where column D (Anwesend) = 1 (they were present)\n5. For each present operator, extract:\n   - callsign (col A)\n   - suffix (col B) - \"p\" means /P, \"m\" or \"mobil\" means /M, \"/8\" means /8, etc.\n   - name (col J, index 9)\n   - QTH (col K, index 10)\n   - Bezirk code (col L, index 11)\n   - Bundesland (col M, index 12) — format like \"01-Wien\", \"08-Kärnten\"\n   - All non-empty rapport values from the repeater columns (cols P through the end of the repeater section)\n   - The repeater name from the header row for that column\n\n6. Output a JSON file at `/tmp/qso_data.json` with structure:\n```json\n{\n  \"sheets\": {\n    \"20260104\": {\n      \"operators\": [\n        {\n          \"callsign\": \"OE1CJG\",\n          \"suffix\": \"p\",\n          \"name\": \"Jozef\",\n          \"qth\": \"Wien 11\",\n          \"bezirk\": \"WC\",\n          \"bundesland\": \"01\",\n          \"reports\": [\n            {\"repeater_header\": \"Gerlitze 2m OE8XNK...\", \"rapport\": \"5/9++ HK\"}\n          ]\n        }\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\nImportant: Only include operators that have Anwesend=1 AND at least one non-empty rapport value. Parse the bundesland code from the \"XX-Name\" format (take just the 2 digits like \"01\", \"08\").\n\nRun the script and then read the output JSON file and return its contents (or a summary if very large).\n",

}

{
  "command": "ssh host-node-01 \"docker exec bosarsalog node -e \\\"\nconst Database = require('better-sqlite3');\nconst db = new Database('/data/bosarsalog.db');\n\n// Get test exercises\nconst exercises = db.prepare(\\\\\\\"SELECT id, name, date, oe_link_enabled FROM exercises WHERE name LIKE '%Testdaten%' ORDER BY date\\\\\\\").all();\nconsole.log('Test exercises:');\nexercises.forEach(e => console.log(JSON.stringify(e)));\n\n// Get all repeaters\nconst reps = db.prepare(\\\\\\\"SELECT id, short_name, bundesland_code, type, is_linked, frequency_mhz FROM repeaters ORDER BY sort_order\\\\\\\").all();\nconsole.log('\\\\nRepeaters:');\nreps.forEach(r => console.log(JSON.stringify(r)));\n\n// Get exercise_repeaters for test exercises\nconsole.log('\\\\nExercise repeaters:');\nfor (const ex of exercises) {\n  const er = db.prepare(\\\\\\\"SELECT er.repeater_id, r.short_name FROM exercise_repeaters er JOIN repeaters r ON r.id = er.repeater_id WHERE er.exercise_id = ?\\\\\\\").all(ex.id);\n  console.log(ex.name + ': ' + er.map(r => r.short_name).join(', '));\n}\n\n// Current report counts\nconsole.log('\\\\nCurrent report counts:');\nfor (const ex of exercises) {\n  const c = db.prepare(\\\\\\\"SELECT COUNT(*) as c FROM signal_reports WHERE exercise_id = ?\\\\\\\").get(ex.id);\n  console.log(ex.name + ': ' + c.c);\n}\n\\\"\"",
  "description": "Get test exercises, repeaters, exercise_repeaters"
}

elif s.startswith(\"/\"):\n            suf = s\n        else:\n            suf = \"/\" + s.upper()\n    reps = \"; \".join([r[\"rapport\"] for r in op[\"reports\"]])\n    print(f\"  {op['callsign']}{suf} [{op['bezirk']}] BL={op['bundesland']}: {reps}\")\n\nall_rapports = set()\nfor op in operators:\n    for r in op[\"reports\"]:\n        all_rapports.add(r[\"rapport\"])\nprint(f\"\\nUnique rapport values ({len(all_rapports)}):\")\nfor r in sorted(all_rapports):\n    print(f\"  {r}\")\n\n# Save to JSON\nwith open(\"/tmp/qso_data.json\", \"w\") as f:\n    json.dump({\"operators\": operators, \"repeater_headers\": repeater_headers}, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)\nprint(\"\\nSaved to /tmp/qso_data.json\")\n"
}

The FK issue is that bezirk_code/bundesland_code values need to exist in the reference tables. The `/P` and `/M` callsigns are included in the callsign itself. Let me fix the script to handle null bezirk/bundesland for international stations:

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_01RFzxfTCk8XLQVSWUgNfJiJ
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/tmp/populate_test_data.js",
  "old_string": "function getOrCreateOperator(callsign, name, bezirk, bundesland) {\n  let op = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM operators WHERE callsign = ?').get(callsign);\n  if (!op) {\n    db.prepare('INSERT INTO operators (callsign, name, bezirk_code, bundesland_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)').run(callsign, name, bezirk, bundesland);\n    op = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM operators WHERE callsign = ?').get(callsign);\n  } else {\n    // Update bezirk/bundesland if missing\n    if (!op.bezirk_code && bezirk) {\n      db.prepare('UPDATE operators SET bezirk_code = ? WHERE id = ?').run(bezirk, op.id);\n    }\n    if (!op.bundesland_code && bundesland) {\n      db.prepare('UPDATE operators SET bundesland_code = ? WHERE id = ?').run(bundesland, op.id);\n    }\n    if (!op.name && name) {\n      db.prepare('UPDATE operators SET name = ? WHERE id = ?').run(name, op.id);\n    }\n  }\n  return op;\n}",
  "new_string": "function getOrCreateOperator(callsign, name, bezirk, bundesland) {\n  // Validate FK references exist\n  if (bezirk) {\n    const bz = db.prepare('SELECT code FROM bezirke WHERE code = ?').get(bezirk);\n    if (!bz) bezirk = null;\n  }\n  if (bundesland) {\n    const bl = db.prepare('SELECT code FROM bundeslaender WHERE code = ?').get(bundesland);\n    if (!bl) bundesland = null;\n  }\n  let op = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM operators WHERE callsign = ?').get(callsign);\n  if (!op) {\n    db.prepare('INSERT INTO operators (callsign, name, bezirk_code, bundesland_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)').run(callsign, name, bezirk || null, bundesland || null);\n    op = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM operators WHERE callsign = ?').get(callsign);\n  } else {\n    if (!op.bezirk_code && bezirk) {\n      db.prepare('UPDATE operators SET bezirk_code = ? WHERE id = ?').run(bezirk, op.id);\n    }\n    if (!op.bundesland_code && bundesland) {\n      db.prepare('UPDATE operators SET bundesland_code = ? WHERE id = ?').run(bundesland, op.id);\n    }\n    if (!op.name && name) {\n      db.prepare('UPDATE operators SET name = ? WHERE id = ?').run(name, op.id);\n    }\n  }\n  return op;\n}"
}

Red bezirk badges (`#dc3545`) mean the bezirk is a **Landeshauptstadt** (state capital). The `is_capital` flag in the `bezirke` table marks capital district codes (e.g. Wien, Graz, Linz, Salzburg, Klagenfurt, Innsbruck, Bregenz, Eisenstadt, St. Pölten).

Grey badges (`#6c757d`) = regular districts, red badges = capital districts. This is a visual distinction carried over from the original Excel sheet design. Want me to change or remove it?

Based on the search results, here's what I found about Austrian political districts (Bezirke) in 2025:

## Overview

As of 2025, there are 79 political districts (politische Bezirke), each serving as a deconcentrated unit for executing federal and state-level administrative tasks. Additionally, the states are subdivided into 80 politische Bezirke (political districts) and 15 Statutarstädte (statutory cities).

## Terminology by Bundesland

The naming conventions vary by federal state: In the provincial laws of Lower Austria and Vorarlberg, districts headed by district commissions are called administrative districts (Verwaltungsbezirke), while in Burgenland, Carinthia, Salzburg, Styria, Upper Austria, and Tyrol, the term used is political district (politischer Bezirk).

## Structure

Within each Land, there is a further subdivision into political districts (politische Bezirke or Verwaltungsbezirke) and statutory cities. A statutory city is a municipality which by law has both municipal and district administrative functions.

The search results indicate that Statistics Austria compiles official data on political districts with key dates as of 2025, though the complete detailed list with all district names by Bundesland wasn't fully displayed in these search results. For the most comprehensive and authoritative list, you may want to consult the Statistics Austria document directly (statistik.at).

Add missing Landeshauptstädte\nconst missingCapitals = [\n  { code: 'E',  name: 'Eisenstadt',      bundesland_code: '04', is_capital: 1 },\n  { code: 'L',  name: 'Linz Stadt',      bundesland_code: '05', is_capital: 1 },\n  { code: 'G',  name: 'Graz Stadt',      bundesland_code: '06', is_capital: 1 },\n  { code: 'I',  name: 'Innsbruck Stadt', bundesland_code: '07', is_capital: 1 },\n];\n\n// 3. ORDER BY code').all(bl.code);\n  const capitalCount = bezirke.filter(b => b.is_capital).length;\n  console.log('\\n' + bl.code + ' ' + bl.name + ' (' + bezirke.length + ' bezirke, ' + capitalCount + ' capital):');\n  for (const b of bezirke) {\n    const marker = b.is_capital ? ' *** LANDESHAUPTSTADT ***' : '';\n    console.log('  ' + b.code + ' | ' + b.name + marker);\n  }\n  totalCount += bezirke.length;\n}\nconsole.log('\\nTotal bezirke: ' + totalCount);\n\n// Sanity check: each Bundesland should have exactly 1 capital\nconsole.log('\\n=== CAPITAL CHECK ===');\nfor (const bl of bundeslaender) {\n  const capitals = db.prepare('SELECT code, name FROM bezirke WHERE bundesland_code = ? AND is_capital = 1').all(bl.code);\n  if (capitals.length === 0) {\n    console.log('WARNING: ' + bl.code + ' ' + bl.name + ' has NO capital!');\n  } else if (capitals.length > 1) {\n    console.log('WARNING: ' + bl.code + ' ' + bl.name + ' has MULTIPLE capitals: ' + capitals.map(c => c.code).join(', '));\n  } else {\n    console.log('OK: ' + bl.code + ' ' + bl.name + ' -> ' + capitals[0].code + ' ' + capitals[0].name);\n  }\n}\n"

WHERE bezirk_code = ?').run(r.newCode, r.oldCode);\n  if (opResult.changes > 0) {\n    console.log('  Updated ' + opResult.changes + ' operators from ' + r.oldCode + ' to ' + r.newCode);\n  }\n\n  // Update signal_reports that reference the old code\n  const srResult = db.prepare('UPDATE signal_reports SET bezirk_code = ? WHERE bezirk_code = ?').run(r.newCode, r.oldCode);\n  if (srResult.changes > 0) {\n    console.log('  Updated ' + srResult.changes + ' signal_reports from ' + r.oldCode + ' to ' + r.newCode);\n  }\n\n  // Update the bezirk code itself\n  const result = db.prepare('UPDATE bezirke SET code = ? WHERE code = ?').run(r.newCode, r.oldCode);\n  if (result.changes > 0) {\n    console.log('Renamed ' + r.oldCode + ' -> ' + r.newCode + ' (' + r.name + ')');\n  } else {\n    console.log('WARNING: ' + r.oldCode + ' not found in bezirke table');\n  }\n}\n\n// Verify\nconsole.log('\\n=== Verification: All capitals ===');\nconst capitals = db.prepare('SELECT b.code, b.name, b.bundesland_code, bl.name as bl_name FROM bezirke b LEFT JOIN bundeslaender bl ON bl.code = b.bundesland_code WHERE b.is_capital = 1 ORDER BY b.bundesland_code').all();\nfor (const c of capitals) {\n  console.log(c.bundesland_code + ' ' + c.bl_name + ': ' + c.code + ' ' + c.name);\n}\n"
}
